deviations.description: Case (r) counterfactual: assert a hash-only rule redeploys every time using DEPLOY_LEDGER_RECENT_SEC=0
deviations.reason: age_sec is computed via date +%s (whole-second granularity); a same-second seed+decide pair could yield age_sec==0, making 0 a flaky threshold for asserting the recency window is never satisfied. -1 is unsatisfiable by any non-negative age and is deterministic.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — used DEPLOY_LEDGER_RECENT_SEC=-1, not 0, for the counterfactual: age is computed as whole seconds via date +%s, so a same-second seed+decide pair could produce age_sec == 0, making 0 a flaky, timing-dependent threshold; -1 is unsatisfiable by any non-negative age and keeps the assertion deterministic.)*
